spanish: Holocausto continuo a generaciones de ustedes, a abertura de tienda de reunión delante de Jehová, que me citaré a ustedes allá para hablar a ti allí.

findings.issue: עֹלַת תָּמִיד is a construct noun plus an absolute noun; continuo makes the absolute noun an adjective. The continual-offering sense remains.
פֶּתַח has no preposition; a makes the bare place noun explicitly locative.
Niphal imperfect 1cs אִוָּעֵד plus לָכֶם is I meet or appoint to you; me citaré a ustedes can also be read as summon or quote.

notes: 2mp ustedes and 2ms ti match לָכֶם and אֵלֶיךָ; Jehová matches יהוה.
